# cpanel_directory_privacy_user (Resource)

Manages one authorized user for a cPanel Directory Privacy password file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_directory_privacy" "downloads" {
  directory = "public_html/downloads"
  auth_name = "Restricted downloads"
}

variable "directory_privacy_user_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "cpanel_directory_privacy_user" "release_bot" {
  directory         = cpanel_directory_privacy.downloads.directory
  username          = "release-bot"
  password          = var.directory_privacy_user_password
  password_version  = 1
  delete_on_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory` (String) The normalized directory path relative to the cPanel account home.
- `username` (String) The username authorized to access the directory.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether deleting the Terraform resource also deletes the authorized user. Defaults to `false`. cPanel does not expose an immutable user identity, so enabling this option accepts that a same-name replacement cannot be distinguished from the managed user.
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The user's HTTP Basic authentication password. Configure it together with `password_version`. Terraform never stores it in plan or state artifacts.
- `password_version` (Number) A positive version that triggers an in-place password update when changed. It must be configured together with `password`.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_directory` (String) The absolute directory path reported by cPanel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_directory_privacy_user.release_bot 'public_html/downloads|release-bot'
```
